principal.definition: Local bulk thickness in cm of all primary airborne TBJ fallout, including co-ignimbrite fallout.

target: Local bulk thickness in cm of all primary airborne TBJ fallout, including co-ignimbrite fallout.

sources.thickness: H is the full package, I–P are A0 through G in centimetres. J, K and P supply A, B and G, with N (mixed E) used only in qualified bounds. G and Q document pre- and post-TBJ material.

corrected_site.position_scope: McNeil (2003), La Laguna de Petapilla p. 6, field position for the pond. Petapilla 2 was recovered in the western sector (p. 7). Individual core coordinates and horizontal datum are unreported.

corrected_site.identity: TBJ, solid white glass-rich bed in Petapilla 2, glass composition compared with an El Salvador reference. Distal integrated fallout with unresolved individual phases.
corrected_site.age: Twig against upper contact, Beta-167234, 1540 ± 40 radiocarbon years BP, reported calibrated 420–620 CE at 2σ.
corrected_site.duplicate: Dull Fig. 9 symbol L02 is an approximate map position for the same pond. The earlier digitization retains its published map pixels. The other Petapilla cores contribute no second quantified TBJ bed.
